GoodsReceivedNote.name: GoodsReceivedNote
GoodsReceivedNote.description: Represents a record created by the buyer to confirm the delivery of goods from a supplier. It is used to verify that the received items match the purchase order. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

GoodsReceivedNoteNumber.description: The unique identifier and primary key for the Goods Received Note.

SupplierAccount.description: The account of the supplier that provides the goods.

GoodsReceivedDate.description: The date and time on which the goods are received.

InvoiceReferenceNumber.description: The invoice number provided by the supplier.

GoodsReceivedLocation.description: The location where the goods are received.

ReceiverAccount.description: The account associated with the user who is receiving the goods.

ReceivedBy.description: The user who is receiving the goods.

Comments.description: Additional notes or remarks related to the Goods Received Note.

StatusCode.description: Indicates the status of the Goods Received Note.

PurchaseOrder.description: The purchase order associated with the Goods Received Note.

UsageType.description: Specifies the context in which the Goods Received Note is created.
